accuracy_findings.claim: A bonus that turns one resource into another reads that resource before its own percentages. See [[mobility]].
accuracy_findings.problem: False as a general rule, and it drops the exception that docs/help-manual.md 8.1 confirmed. Only a percentage-type conversion (the Mobility credit bonus, type :mul) reads the value from before the percentages. Its input comes from base_state (bonus.ex:95), and base_state only changes after an :add runs (bonus.ex:51-55). A flat conversion (type :add, e.g. finance_open, +2 credits per mobility, building-slow.ex:1527) reads the current state (bonus.ex:94), so it sees mobility after its percentages. Its add runs at pipeline order 30, after the mobility percentages at order 29, and that updates base_state. So in a system with such a building, or with Monument dome (sys_pop -> ideology add, building-slow.ex:1270, also order 30), the Mobility bonus reads 33 too. The mobility page states only the simple rule and links back to [[bonus-stacking]], which now points at this section. The exception is therefore documented on neither page.
accuracy_findings.fix: State the rule for the percentage-type conversion only, then add the exception in one or two sentences. Example: 'The Mobility bonus reads mobility from before mobility's percentages. A building that turns mobility into credits reads it after them. In a system with such a building, or with {name:building.monument_dome}, the Mobility bonus reads it after them too.' Keep the See [[mobility]] pointer.

accuracy_findings.problem: This is wrong for most credit percentages a player gets. Almost every credit percentage from a Lex or tradition works at the empire level (type :mul on :player_credit): credit_perc_1 +10 % (doctrine-slow.ex:471), credit_2 +15 % (:490), credit_3 +40 % (:511), spy_def_2 +5 % (:461) and tech_2 +5 % (:678). Each system's whole credit total, Mobility bonus included, enters the player pipeline as a flat :direct add (player.ex:1024-1030). An :add updates base_state, so those percentages count the Mobility bonus. Only a percentage on the system's own credit skips it, for example the governor's Mafioso skill, +5 % sys_credit (character.ex:90), or the pillage-mutator system credit percentages. A player with the +40 % Lex who reads 'never' will expect too little credit.
accuracy_findings.fix: Narrow the sentence to percentages on the system's own credit, or cut it. For example: 'A percentage on the system's credit, like a governor's, does not count the {ui:resource-detail.misc.population_mobility}. Percentages on your empire's credit, like most Lexes, do.' Or drop the sentence and leave this to [[credit]] and [[mobility]], since the brief says this page does not own the Mobility bonus.

Player side, with the system credit as a :direct add and a +10 % player_credit Lex: player credit 55.0, doctrine part 5.0 = 10 % of 50, so the 30 from the Mobility bonus is counted. System-level check (tmp/help-review/system-outputs-acc-r1-check.exs): with a +50 % sys_credit bonus, credit is 60.0 = 50 + 0.5 x 20, so a system-level percentage does skip the Mobility bonus.
